answer: Require every agent to stake a bond of timber-harvest credits before it can trade: the bond is locked in a public escrow, and a single verified identity can hold only one active bond. Each trade then emits a signed signal that peers can audit against the bond registry, so duplicate identities must buy a fresh bond for every fake. Forging a dune of sockpuppets stops paying once bond cost exceeds the profit from one extra identity, because each clone burns its own stake when caught.
